walkableNote: PHASE 2A: THE FLOOR NOW REACHES THE BAR. It used to turn in at x 1170 (y 690) and run down to 1400 at the frame's foot, leaving a wedge of real dirt -- up to 440 px of it, with the three stools standing on it -- that Thad could not enter. He could never stand AT the counter, only out in the room looking at it, which is why it read across his shoulders. The right edge now follows the bar's own plinth line, read off a ruled 2x crop: (1205,620) (1500,715) (1700,790) (1830,845) (1860,864). The three stools become obstacles so he cannot stand inside one, and the bar patrons' zones are unchanged -- they are actors, not walls. Doc 36 Q126.

scaling.note: PHASE 2A, TYLER: "Thad looks too small next to the bar." His art is frozen, so the room changed. THE CURVE IS RESCALED BY 1.145 AND ITS SHAPE IS UNTOUCHED -- 198/459 became 227/526 on the same horizon (y 239) -- which is the median of eight dimensioned things measured off this plate at 3x and 4x (reference/room-03-candidate/furniture-measurements.json). THE READINGS DO NOT AGREE with each other: at the same depth the card table says a 222 px man and the piano says 356. That is what a painted room is, and it is why this takes a median rather than crowning one object. The three bar stools alone agree with the OLD curve; the counter and the piano do not. THE CURVE WAS NOT THE WHOLE DEFECT, and this is the part no rescale could have fixed: the walkable floor turned in at x 1170-1379 and stopped up to 440 px short of the bar's own plinth, so wherever Thad stood the counter was at a SHALLOWER depth than he was and read across his shoulders -- 0.87 of his stature, measured. Carrying the floor to the plinth puts it at 0.63, waist and lower ribs, which is where a bar belongs on a man. The study is proofs/room-03/phase2a-scale-study.json and renders/opening-set-retrofit/phase2a-nugget-scale.webp; the candidates are scale-candidates.json beside this file. STILL WRONG AND NOT FIXED: the painted piano tops him at every candidate -- it reads about 1.7 m against furniture that reads 1.75 m men. The environment is OWNER-ACCEPTED AND FROZEN, and the only fix is repainting it, so it is recorded for Tyler rather than corrected.

lampsNote: NO CHANDELIER LAMP. Doc 16: the chandelier is not lit, and the candidate paints its candles cold. A lamp declaration would breathe a pool under a thing the writing says is dark, which is exactly the contradiction the shipping room carried (it declared a chandelier pool of 0.1 over the middle of the room). The practical-light hierarchy is the stove first, the bar lamps second, the door lamp third, and the blue street through the doors, which is not a lamp.
